key.name: enabled-docks
key.summary: 活动/已启用的 Dock 栏名称数组
key.description: 包含启动时创建并加载的 Dock 栏名称列表

key.name: alignment
key.summary: Dock 栏沿显示器边缘的对齐方式
key.description: 可选值为 "fill"(充满), "start"(靠前), "end"(靠后), "center"(居中)。

key.name: auto-pinning
key.summary: 自动固定常用应用程序
key.description: 为 true 时，自动固定可能有用的常用应用程序。

key.name: current-workspace-only
key.summary: 仅显示当前工作区的窗口
key.description: 为 true 时，除了固定项外仅显示当前工作区中未固定的窗口。

key.name: dock-items
key.description: 此 Dock 栏的 dockitem 文件数组。由系统自动管理与更新，请勿手动编辑。

key.name: free-dock-items
key.summary: 自由模式 Dock 项文件数组
key.description: 未分类自由模式下的 dockitem 文件数组。系统自动维护，请勿手动编辑。

key.name: categorized-dock-items
key.summary: 分类模式 Dock 项文件数组
key.description: 分类抽屉模式下的 dockitem 文件数组。系统自动维护，请勿手动编辑。

key.name: hide-delay
key.description: 触发隐藏 Dock 前的延迟时间，单位为毫秒。

key.name: hide-mode
key.description: 可选值为 "none"(不隐藏), "intelligent"(智能避让), "auto"(自动隐藏), "dodge-maximized"(避让最大化窗口), "window-dodge"(避让窗口), "dodge-active"(避让活动窗口)。

key.name: icon-size
key.description: Dock 图标的首选像素大小。

key.name: items-alignment
key.description: 可选值为 "fill"(充满), "start"(靠前), "end"(靠后), "center"(居中)。

key.name: lock-items
key.description: 为 true 时，禁止拖拽并锁定所有图标位置。

key.name: monitor
key.summary: Dock 栏显示的显示器名称
key.description: 指定显示器的接口名称 (例如 DP-1, HDMI-1)。留空则保持在主显示器上。

key.name: offset
key.description: Dock 栏相对居中位置的偏移百分比。

key.name: pinned-only
key.description: 为 true 时，只显示已固定的应用程序项。

key.name: position
key.summary: The position for the dock on the monitor
key.description: 可选值为 "left"(左侧), "right"(右侧), "top"(顶部), "bottom"(底部)。

key.name: window-click-behavior
key.description: 0 smart, 1 focus, 2 cycle, 3 kwin workspace grid, 4 kwin present windows.

key.name: multi-window-behavior
key.description: 0 kwin present windows, 1 kwin workspace grid, 2 dockbar preview cards, 3 cycle, 4 focus.

key.name: show-minimized-previews
key.description: Retain preview icons for minimized windows in a dedicated category next to trash.

key.name: show-window-cards
key.description: Display floating visual preview cards when interacting with applications that have multiple open windows.

key.name: restore-minimized-windows
key.description: Restore minimized windows when cycling application windows.

key.name: show-running-indicators
key.description: Show one or two indicators for running application windows.

key.name: show-attention-indicators
key.description: Show urgent application attention indicators.

key.name: pressure-reveal
key.description: If true, use pressure-based revealing of the dock if the input device supports it.

key.name: show-dock-item
key.summary: Show the item for the dock itself
key.description: If true, show the Plank dock item.

key.name: theme
key.summary: The name of the dock theme for Plank to use
key.description: Built-in values include "Default", "Matte", "Transparent", and "Gtk+".

key.name: tooltips-enabled
key.summary: Show tooltips when items are hovered
key.description: If true, tooltips will be shown when dock items are hovered with the cursor.

key.name: unhide-delay
key.description: Length of the delay before unhiding the dock, in milliseconds.

key.name: zoom-enabled
key.description: If true, zoom dock items when hovered with the cursor.

key.name: categorize-items
key.description: If true, group items into folders, pinned apps, docklets, unpinned apps, and trash with dynamic separators.

key.name: accordion-docklets
key.description: When Categorize Items is enabled, collapse docklets so only the first one on the left is visible at rest, expanding in-line on hover.

key.name: accordion-click-to-expand
key.description: When true, docklets accordion expands only when clicking the Master Preferences icon instead of on hover.

key.name: accordion-delay
key.description: Length of the delay before auto-collapsing docklets, in milliseconds.

key.name: zoom-percent
key.description: The amount to zoom dock items, in percent.

key.name: scroll-overflow
key.description: If true, smoothly scroll items with mouse wheel when dock overflows monitor space instead of shrinking icons to fit.

key.name: system-menu-access
key.summary: System menu and preferences access mode
key.description: 1 Docklets only (no fallback), 2 Docklets only with fallback, 3 All icons, 4 Dedicated icon on dock.
